summary.name: Text With Jesus
summary.one_liner: A Christian AI chatbot app where users chat with Jesus, Bible figures, and spiritual counselors, with scripture, prayer, devotional, and Bible study tools.
use_cases: Chatting with biblical figures about personal struggles
Getting daily Bible verses for devotion
Planning daily prayer and devotional routines
Receiving voice messages from Bible characters
Exploring biblical narratives in a conversational way
summary.what_it_does: The app lets users chat with Jesus, the Holy Family, Apostles, prophets and other Bible figures using AI, with a list that includes figures such as Moses, Daniel, and Elijah. It offers Voicemails, where figures leave spoken messages in their own voice, and users can also convert text replies into Voicemails. It provides daily Bible verses, a prayer companion, a devotional planner, and built-in Bible study tools. Users can select a faith tradition, which shapes the doctrines used in responses and the spiritual counselors offered. The page states the AI is trained on public-domain Bible versions and aims to keep responses in line with biblical teaching.
notable: Voicemails: figures leave spoken messages in distinct voices
Choice of faith tradition that shapes responses and counselors
Premium tier adds unlimited figures, Advanced Reasoning, and conversation threads
Figure memories persist per figure and can be erased
caveats: Full range of figures and unlimited messaging require a premium subscription
Voicemail credits are limited (30 per month for premium), with extra credit packs purchasable
Mac app does not yet support the account-sync feature; the web app is suggested instead
